name: sha256-object-model
setup:
git init -q --object-format=sha256 -b main . &&
printf 'hello\n' > a && printf '' > empty && git add a empty &&
GIT_AUTHOR_DATE='@1112911993 +0000' GIT_COMMITTER_DATE='@1112911993 +0000' git commit -q -m c1

name: sha256-pack-index
setup:
git init -q --object-format=sha256 -b main . &&
for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do printf '%s\n' "$i" > f$i && git add f$i && GIT_AUTHOR_DATE="@$((1112911993+i)) +0000" GIT_COMMITTER_DATE="@$((1112911993+i)) +0000" git commit -q -m c$i; done &&
git repack -q -a -d
probes: git fsck --strict 2>&1 | grep -viE 'checking|^$' | head -2; echo fsck-done

name: sha256-refs-log
setup:
git init -q --object-format=sha256 -b main . &&
printf 'x\n' > x && git add x && GIT_AUTHOR_DATE='@1112911993 +0000' GIT_COMMITTER_DATE='@1112911993 +0000' git commit -q -m c1 &&
git branch dev && git tag -a v1 -m v1

name: sha1-still-works
setup:
git init -q -b main . &&
printf 'y\n' > y && git add y && GIT_AUTHOR_DATE='@1112911993 +0000' GIT_COMMITTER_DATE='@1112911993 +0000' git commit -q -m c1
